p: after that which appeared unto me: After the general vision, he comes to certain particular visions with regard to the destruction of the monarchy of the Persians, and Macedonians: for the ruin of the Babylonians was at hand, and also he had sufficiently spoken of it.
of Elam: That is, of Persia.
ram which had two horns: Which represented the kingdom of the Persians and Medes, which were united together.
higher than the other: Meaning Cyrus, who after grew greater in power than Darius his uncle and father-in-law.
beasts might stand before him: That is, no kings or nations.
an he goat came from the: Meaning Alexander that came from Greece with great speed and warlike undertaking.

horn between his eyes: Even though he came in the name of all Greece, yet he bore the title and dignity of the general captain, so that the strength was attributed to him, which is meant by this horn.
smote the ram: Alexander overcame Darius in two different battles, and so had the two kingdoms of the Medes and Persians.
horn was broken: Alexander's great power was broken: for when he had overcome all the East, he thought to return towards Greece to subdue those that had rebelled, and so died along the way.

notable ones toward the four winds: That is, who were famous: for almost in the space of fifteen years there were fifteen different successors before this monarchy was divided to these four, of which Cassander had Macedonia, Seleucus had Syria, Antigonus had Asia the less, and Ptolemeus had Egypt.

little horn: Which was Antiochus Epiphanes, who was of a servile and flattering nature, and also there were others between him and the kingdom: and therefore he is here called the little horn, because neither princely conditions, nor any other thing was in him, why he should obtain this kingdom.
south: That is, towards Egypt.
east: By which he means Ptolemais.
pleasant land: That is, Judea.
host of heaven: Antiochus raged against the elect of God, and tread his precious stars underfoot, who are so called because they are separated from the world.
prince of the host: That is, God, who governs and maintains his Church.

daily sacrifice was taken away: He laboured to abolish all religion, and therefore cast God's service out of his temple, which God had chosen as a little corner from all the rest of the world to have his name there truly called upon.

an host was given him against: He shows that their sins are the cause of these horrible afflictions: and yet comforts them, in that he appoints this tyrant for a time, whom he would not allow to utterly abolish his religion.
cast down the truth to the: This horn will abolish for a time the true doctrine, and so corrupt God's service.
saint speaking: Meaning that he heard one of the angels asking this question of Christ, whom he called a certain one, or a secret one, or a marvellous one.
desolation: That is, the Jews' sins, which were the cause of its destruction.
host to be trodden under foot: That is, which suppresses God's religion and his people.
he said unto me: Christ answered me for the comfort of the Church.
two thousand and three hundred days: That is, until so many natural days have passed, which make six years, and three and a half months: for the temple was profaned this long under Antiochus.
as the appearance of a man: Who was Christ who in this manner declared himself to the old fathers, how he would be God manifest in flesh.
make this man to understand the: This power to command the angel, declared that he was God.
at the time of the end: The effect of this vision will not yet appear, until a long time after.
end of the indignation: Meaning that great rage which Antiochus would show against the Church.
out of the nation: That is, out of Greece.
in his power: They will not have similar power as Alexander had.
fierce countenance: Noting that this Antiochus was impudent and cruel, and also crafty so that he could not be deceived.
by his own power: That is, not like Alexander's strength.
mighty and the holy people: Both the Gentiles that dwelt around him, and also the Jews.
policy also he shall cause craft: Whatever he goes about by his craft, he will bring it to pass.
peace shall destroy many: That is, under pretence of peace, or as it were in sport.
Prince of princes: Meaning, against God.
without hand: For God would destroy him with a notable plague, and so comfort his Church.
evening and the morning which was: Read Dan 8:14.
certain days: Because of fear and astonishment.
